description_en: Modifies the switching time of a pending event
description_zh: 修改待处理事件的任务切换时间
name: ModifyPendingMaintenanceAction

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query the region ID details
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看地域ID详情。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task. You can specify multiple task IDs at a time to modify the switching time of the tasks in a unified manner. The task IDs must be separated with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 目标任务ID，您也可以同时输入多个任务ID，统一修改这些任务的切换时间，多个任务ID间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en: The time that you specify for the background to perform the action that corresponds to the pending event. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 后台将在指定时间点执行目标待处理任务所对应的操作。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
